title: Widle
description:
Widle is a cozy 2D pixel-art idle simulation where you nurture a tiny desktop planter. Plant a seed and check in whenever you like. Watch your sprout grow and bloom into a beautiful plant. Use your coins to unlock new plant species, pot skins, and fun desk decorations. No timers, no pressure, just a simple, little plant you can tend at your own pace.

Idle Growth
Your plant earns experience in real time. Come back whenever you like to water your sprout or harvest what it's grown for coins, then reinvest those coins to unlock brand-new species.

Endless Customization
Choose from a collection of decorative pot skins, desk accessories, and background themes. Arrange your little desktop garden any way you want, no two setups will ever look the same.

Relaxing Pixel Art & Soundscape
Enjoy hand-crafted 2D pixel visuals with a warm color palette. Ambient desk noises and gentle click effects help you unwind while your garden grows.

Progression & Unlockables
Unlock exotic new plants like sunflowers, rare succulents, and more as you grow your garden. Earn achievement milestones for caring for your tiny green friends, and show off your progress to fellow plant lovers.
description_short: Widle is a cozy 2D pixel-art idle simulation in which you tend a tiny desktop planter, watch your plant grow over time and use earned coins to unlock new species and decorative pot skins.
